# David Facer

David Facer is a product leader and enterprise architect. Since 2005 he has built product functions, owned platform APIs and run enterprise architecture at business-unit scope, at HP, NICE InContact, West Corporation and eLoyalty/TeleTech. He frames architecture as a capital investment judged by its return.

This file is a plain index of what this site holds. It is written by hand, last revised 2026-11-04. If a line here disagrees with the page it describes, the page is right.

## This site

- [Home](https://davidfacer.com/): product leadership as the frame, and how David works, in three areas, each ending on a proof.
- [CV](https://davidfacer.com/professional/cv/): roles, dates and scope of responsibility.
- [CV download](https://davidfacer.com/professional/cv/David_Facer_CV.pdf): the record behind the results on the home page, as a PDF.
- [Prototypes](https://davidfacer.com/sampleprototypes/): the working prototypes.
- [Economic Complexity & Sovereignty Assessment](https://davidfacer.com/complexity-sovereignty-assessment/): a prototype that applies an assessment method to nations, scoring each country for economic complexity and for sovereignty and strategic autonomy, with a reading of the gap between the two. The page renders in the browser, so this line carries what it is.

## Published elsewhere

- [aimaturitymodels.com](https://aimaturitymodels.com): the AI-Native Maturity Model family, open models with free self-assessments, plus Strata, the architectural governance plane, and a set of function models. Its own map lists the models.
- [The map](https://aimaturitymodels.com/llms.txt): that site's index.
- [The full text](https://aimaturitymodels.com/llms-full.txt): the models' full text is there, not in this file.
- [AI-Native SDLC Maturity Model](https://aimaturitymodels.com/models/sdlc/whole-model-view/): the model David wrote, in one view.
- [Strata](https://aimaturitymodels.com/strata/): the governance plane.
- [Professional Substack](https://maturitymodel.substack.com/): essays on product strategy, architecture, and how teams build.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidfacer): his profile.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/superdtf-0882): his public repositories.
